profile.summary: East Bay Art Therapy is a creative arts therapy practice based in Oakland, California. It offers individual, family, couples and group therapy that combines art-making with talk therapy. It also runs workshops and workplace wellness programs, and works with community partners such as K-12 schools and hospitals.
